name: USER-ADMIN-G4
status: candidate; pending controller and consumer review
scope: admin user JWT plus live server-side operation permissions
envelope: code/msg/data; null data omitted; Java Long values and pagination total are decimal strings; dates yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
semantics: permissions and account status re-read from user database on each operation; *:*:* is honored only when granted by active DB role/menu
non-wildcard actor can grant only owned active roles and menus; core role grant restricted to actor user 1
user 1, role 1, roles with reserved core keys admin/super_admin/superadmin and their assigned users/menus are immutable via management endpoints; actor cannot modify own account via admin endpoints
reserved role keys admin, super_admin, superadmin cannot be created or assigned by role edits
changes are serialized by a database lock and rolled back if the last active administrator with system:user:edit or *:*:* would lose that ability
user creation creates type 1 server-side; ordinary update never changes userName, type or password
password reset, account changes and deletion invalidate all known target sid sessions; Redis failure returns 503 after durable intent
user 1 and role 1 protection, last-manager invariant and restricted grants are intentional changes versus the monolith
old Redis sessions issued before G4 lack SQL session records and require controlled key retirement or expiry during cutover

errors.403: missing authority or attempted privilege escalation
errors.503: database or authority unavailable; mutation may have committed and is recoverable

validation: H2 MySQL-mode and session-port stubs only; actual MySQL/Redis ACL and gateway unverified
